description: Add a card to a portal's dashboard. Types (module_type): 2=a chart, 3=a map, 4=a calendar (module_id: its id); 9=a table or report; 10=the sum of a field; 11=the average of a field; 12=the number of records; 13=records added today; 14=records changed today; 15=a link; 16=a page; 17=growth of a table over a period (module_id, date_property_id, change_period); 18=growth between two cards (first_widget_id, second_widget_id); 5=the account's files total; 6=the number of the portal's people. Several charts for a dashboard: create_dashboard_charts.

block_height.description: Height of the card in px

block_width.description: Width of the card in the grid (1-12, bootstrap grid)

change_period.description: For growth: 0 = yesterday vs the day before, 1 = this week vs last week, 2 = this month vs last month, 3 = quarter, 4 = year

currency_position.description: 0 = before the number (default), 1 = after the number

date_property_id.description: ID or name of the date field — for growth_by_table (17), to count the records per period

first_widget_id.description: ID of the first dashboard widget for growth_by_widgets (18) — take it from a previous add_dashboard_item

icon.description: The icon's FontAwesome class (optional, chosen automatically if not given)

module_id.description: The table's or report's id (types 9–14, 17) / the chart's (2), map's (3) or calendar's (4) id

module_type.description: 2=chart, 3=map, 4=calendar, 9=table or report, 10=sum, 11=average, 12=count, 13=added today, 14=changed today, 15=link, 16=page, 17=growth by table, 18=growth between cards, 5=files total, 6=portal's people

position.description: Position in the grid (autoincrement if not given)

property_id.description: ID or name of the number field — for sum (10), average (11). For growth (17): the field that is counted.

second_widget_id.description: ID of the second dashboard widget for growth_by_widgets (18)

show_compare_period.description: Show the value for the compared period (default: false)

show_currency.description: Show the currency symbol next to the number

show_current_value.description: Show the current value next to the % of growth (default: true)

name: add_dashboard_item
